question: Can a fixed local is/was contrast at resid10 compute the later donor-free q_is root gain with four affine coefficients and preserve selective causal effects?

novelty_search.nearest_positive: For has/had, a resid10 local unembedding contrast plus four direction-affine coefficients prospectively replaced a final-head root/grid controller. No upstream read or gain map exists for the distinct q_is writer.
novelty_search.new_question: Fit only intercept+slope per direction from v4 A1 resid10 current-minus-other is/was contrast to immutable root alpha, then causally test v4 A2/P/C without root search.
novelty_search.scope: This is a design-seen upstream-computation screen. A pass must be frozen and tested on another disjoint capability-qualified lexicon before identification.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: q_is, rank one, reader rows, affine form, and four-parameter count are fixed. No rank, feature, regularization, clipping, or coefficient sweep.

frozen_design.calibration: All 16 v4 A1 rows; response is the immutable root alpha. Each direction has eight rows.
frozen_design.feature: At source resid10, exact soft-capped current-minus-other is/was local margin; current is the base tense and other is the requested tense.
frozen_design.fit: Separate float64 ordinary least-squares intercept+slope per direction; exactly four coefficients, no ridge/clipping/grid.
frozen_design.causal_test: Apply predicted alpha*q_is at source resid18 to all v4 A2, P (from answer-preserving donor surface), and C (alternating intended is/was direction); score exact final head. No root, donor activation/margin, row target/foil IDs, or outcomes select alpha.
frozen_design.next_if_screen: Freeze coefficients before constructing/opening a fifth disjoint lexicon.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_and_exact_hea: Hashes, row/root-alpha alignment, basis, fixed IDs, and exact resid10/resid18 head replay <=1e-3 pass.
predictions.pred_b_upstream_affine_fit: Each direction has eight nondegenerate finite rows and calibration R2>=0.50; every causal alpha exactly equals its direction's intercept+slope*resid10 feature and uses no forbidden input.
predictions.pred_c_design_seen_A2: A2 mean recovery >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_d_design_seen_P: P mean margin reflection >=0.75 with direction fraction >=0.75.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: Exactly 16 calibration and 48 causal records within 16 forwards/240 examples, zero grid/backward/update, and exactly four fit scalars.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: freeze the upstream four-scalar q_is controller for a fifth-lexicon prospective test.
terminal.null: Valid affine fit or A2/P/C effect misses; retain root controller and do not add features/rank.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, head, fit integrity, actuator identity, or coverage fails.
